topScam.title: The Bogus Stock Market "VIP Institutional IPO" Group
topScam.scam: You are added to a WhatsApp group named after a famous global brokerage. "Mentors" promise guaranteed 100% allocation in blockbuster IPOs and instruct you to trade through a customized app. The app shows massive fake profits, but when you attempt to withdraw, they demand a 20% "tax release fee" and freeze your account.
topScam.protection: SEBI-registered brokerages never conduct institutional IPO bidding or accept investments via WhatsApp groups. Never deposit money into personal accounts for stock market trading.
topScam.sourceName: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

realityPick.title: The "Replace Junior Engineers" Fallacy
realityPick.myth: AI coding agents write code 5x faster, so we can freeze junior hiring and cut our engineering headcount by 30-40% this fiscal year.
realityPick.reality: AI dramatically increases code generation velocity, but it causes a 3x surge in pull request volume, architectural drift, and subtle hallucinated edge-case bugs. Senior engineers spend 60% of their day reviewing AI-generated diffs instead of designing systems. Cutting juniors destroys the future talent pipeline and creates an institutional knowledge void within 18 months.
realityPick.fix: Treat AI as leverage to elevate junior engineers to mid-level velocity, not a headcount reduction tool. Enforce strict diff-budget caps, automated test-coverage gates, and mandatory human architectural review boundaries.
realityPick.impact: Unchecked AI diff volume overwhelms senior engineers, causes catastrophic production regressions, and eliminates institutional knowledge transfer.
